descriptionHtml:
Approach · TC-22 Task Closure & Extraction · S05 AI Check, Nursing Home (5 of the 10): the UAT script on five residents with the three tasks typed by hand

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U2 Save & Extract closes the open tasks whose results are dictated in ordinary phrasing ('BMP came back, creatinine 1.1'; 'PT saw her, walking with a walker'). … (UAT TC-22; TFA-92592 AC 2) — gate: blocked: TFA-92592 ready for pr
  • U3 No duplicates: closing a task adds no new task for the same item, and Save & Extract never adds a task that is already on the list, open or closed (UAT TC-22; TFA-92592 AC 2) — gate: blocked: TFA-92592 ready for pr
  • U4 The task whose result is not dictated ('recheck weight in two weeks') stays open (UAT TC-22; TFA-92592 AC 2) — gate: blocked: TFA-92592 ready for pr
  • U5 A conditional order ('advance diet to clears if pain stays under 4') becomes a task (UAT TC-22; TFA-92592 AC 3) — gate: blocked: TFA-92592 ready for pr
  • U6 A retraction ('leave glargine at 20') does not become a task (UAT TC-22; TFA-92592 AC 3) — gate: blocked: TFA-92592 ready for pr
  • U7 Monitoring-phrased physician orders are extracted as tasks (UAT TC-22; TFA-92592 AC 3) — gate: blocked: TFA-92592 ready for pr
  • U8 All of the above in Nursing Home as well as Hospital, passing in both (UAT TC-22 step 4; UAT 3.3; TFA-92592 AC 14) — gate: blocked: TFA-92592 ready for pr
  • U9 AI Check threshold: at least 10 independent scenarios (5 Hospital, 5 Nursing Home), passing at 9/10 or better, every failure quoted; graded against EVALUATION_FRAMEWORK.md (UAT TC-22; UAT 3.2; TFA-94229 AC 2) — gate: blocked: TFA-94229 in progress; TFA-92592 ready for pr; …
  • U10 Never invent, never drop: a task made from the dictation contains nothing that was not dictated (no added dose, route, frequency or urgency, no supplied decision) and keeps what was dictated, includi … (UAT 3.4; TFA-94229 R8; TFA-94229 R9) — gate: blocked: TFA-94229 in progress
  • U12 Each run records which AI ran each step: the model for task extraction (parsing.extractTasks) and for the Hospital pre-round processing, and whether the backup model was used (UAT 3.9; UAT 3.1)

Test design technique: Equivalence classes (equivalence) — Check the same rule again with another class of input (Hospital / Nursing Home, other data); every class has to be right.

Given Five independent Nursing Home residents with three open tasks each (typed by hand, Q3) and a bedside dictation with two results, one conditional order and one retraction; N-02…N-05 also carry one monitoring-phrased physician order, N-04 also restates its open weight task (N-01 is the UAT wording verbatim)

When Run Save & Extract through ai/parsing:extractTasks with the Nursing Home client's arguments (first 1,200 characters) and merge

Then Per fixture: the two answered tasks done, the third open, exactly the expected tasks added (the conditional one keeping its condition and, in N-02…N-05, the monitoring one keeping its frequency or threshold), no task for the retraction or a dictated result, none urgent, no undictated unit, nothing duplicated. …

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): Same as S04; counts toward the 9/10 in S04 + S05; N-01's re-tap is the Nursing Home half of U3 (Q5 c), reported beside the fixture

Where it ran: dev; test method AICHECK · AI output check; lane planned in the matrix: AI check (automated)

S05 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-22.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: dev — dev deployment, build e02167f (Deploy Convex, 2026-10-12T18:24:27Z); account and address are not written into the report; run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev.

Test method: AICHECK · AI output check; secondary: AGENT · Browser agent — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: dev.
